title: FabricLA Acrylic Felt Fabric, 72in Wide 1.6mm, 1 Yard Pre Cut (Camel)

comparisons.notes: Brand's own store: 100% acrylic felt, 72in wide, 1.6mm, Camel / 1 Yard variant $18.99, available

writeup: Woot has one yard of FabricLA's 100% acrylic felt in Camel for $9.99. It is 72 inches wide and 1.6mm thick, ships as one pre-cut piece, and cut edges don't fray, which makes it handy for stockings, tree skirts and other holiday crafts. FabricLA charges $18.99 for the same 1-yard cut on its own site. Only 1 was left when checked.
amazon_match_notes: Amazon listing: FabricLA Felt Fabric 72in Wide 1.6mm Acrylic Felt, Camel, 1 Yard Pre Cut (MPN Felt-CML-1Y) - same as Woot
